title: Redis
description: Namespaced Redis and Valkey GET, SET, TTL, EXPIRE, INCR, SCAN and DELETE tools. Read-only by default; bounded UTF-8 data and explicit expiry.

tool_redis.host.title: Host
tool_redis.host.description: Redis host reachable from the engine, or rediss://host:port for TLS. Cloud requires TLS and exclusively public addresses; local engines allow localhost.

tool_redis.db.title: Database
tool_redis.db.description: Standalone logical database index; must exist on the server.

tool_redis.password.title: Password
tool_redis.password.description: Redis password or a RocketRide secret reference. Stored as a secure credential field.

tool_redis.use_tls.title: Use TLS
tool_redis.use_tls.description: Enable TLS with required certificate and hostname verification.

tool_redis.key_prefix.title: Key prefix
tool_redis.key_prefix.description: Required literal app/environment namespace using letters, digits, colon, underscore or hyphen. Always prepended; not per-user authorization.

tool_redis.allow_writes.title: Allow writes
tool_redis.allow_writes.description: Enable SET, EXPIRE, INCR and DELETE. Read-only by default; every mutation checks this setting.

tool_redis.default_ttl_seconds.title: Default TTL (seconds)
tool_redis.default_ttl_seconds.description: Expiry when SET omits ttl_seconds; 0 means persistent. SET replaces an existing expiry.

tool_redis.socket_connect_timeout.title: Connect timeout (seconds)
tool_redis.socket_connect_timeout.description: Maximum time for a connection attempt.

tool_redis.socket_timeout.title: Socket timeout (seconds)
tool_redis.socket_timeout.description: Maximum socket wait per command. No automatic command retries.

tool_redis.max_connections.title: Maximum connections
tool_redis.max_connections.description: Finite pool size per node/pipeline; exhausted pools return an error rather than waiting indefinitely.

tool_redis.max_value_bytes.title: Maximum value bytes
tool_redis.max_value_bytes.description: UTF-8 payload cap, at most 64 KiB. Serialized results are additionally capped at 128 KiB.
